summary: Phase 5.8A Capital Scaling Validation testing complete. 39 pytest tests PASSED (22 unit tests + 9 endpoint contract + 8 regression). Frontend /admin/futures/scaling-validation page loads correctly with all required panels including stress replay dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/admin/futures/scaling-validation returns correct contract: generated_at, scaling_performance_report, scaling_robustness_score, robustness_state, robustness_components, robustness_weights, scaling_governance_actions, stress_replay_dashboard
GET /api/admin/futures/scaling-report returns correct contract: generated_at, scaling_performance_report, scaling_robustness_score, robustness_state, stress_replay_dashboard
Capital scaling simulator deterministic for 1M/10M/100M levels with pnl, slippage, execution_quality, liquidity_stress metrics
Liquidity impact model correctly models impact_ratio and impact_score with tier multipliers (HIGH=0.8, MEDIUM=1.0, LOW=1.25)
Slippage simulator uses volatility regime multipliers (LOW=0.8, NORMAL=1.0, HIGH=1.35, EXTREME=1.8)
Stress replay engine supports 4 scenarios: high_volatility (vol=1.6, liq=0.75), low_liquidity (vol=1.2, liq=0.55), flash_crash (vol=2.2, liq=0.4), liquidation_cascade (vol=1.9, liq=0.5)
Robustness score state transitions: scalable (>=80), caution (60-79), unstable (<60)
Weights are config-driven via Settings class: scaling_weight_pnl_stability, scaling_weight_slippage_impact, scaling_weight_execution_quality, scaling_weight_liquidity_stress (default 0.25 each)
Response includes robustness_weights field confirming config-driven weights
Scaling governance adapter outputs: capital_cap_recommendation (1.0/0.8/0.55), risk_downshift (true/false), strategy_disable (true if score<45 and unstable)

Frontend page /admin/futures/scaling-validation renders all required panels: robustness score, state, capital cap, risk downshift, capital comparison, slippage chart, pnl stability, liquidity impact, stress replay dashboard
Navigation link nav-admin-futures-scaling-validation-link present and functional
All 8 regression endpoints verified working: live-readiness, tail-risk, capital-drift, cluster-risk, strategy-governance, strategy-performance, capital-budget, capital-usage
